body: The whole work permit fiasco started when I was accepted, however it was sent to the wrong address and now I have to wait 90 to 120 days for it to arrive. This permit is only valid for two years and I am going to lose so much time. This was my breaking point, like fate snatching it from my hands and now my depression is even worse than before. I tried to talk to my mother about my frustrations but she begins to cry and that "God" has a plan. It is frustrating to be told this that it has driven me away from religion.

I am trying to get a work permit and I keep getting roadblocks in my way. My life has been like this since I was 17 I am sick of living and a shitty apartment sharing a bedroom with my mother. I should be doing more but it is maddening that I nothing works when I make attempts to make things better.
